description: FP-Growth on one prepared transaction/item table. New nodes require all fields. Existing omissions preserve saved settings. Train current input before Execute; no saved-model apply in this slice.

transaction_field.description: Exact technical name of the discrete string transaction-ID field on input 0. Distinct from item_field; all rows sharing an ID form one basket. Not a display label.

item_field.description: Exact technical name of the discrete string item field on input 0. One item per row. NULL, empty values and repeated transaction/item pairs are outside the prepared-input contract.

min_support_pct.description: Inclusive minimum support in percent, not a fraction: 50 means half of distinct transactions. Applied to frequent sets and rules.

min_confidence_pct.description: Inclusive minimum rule confidence in percent: 60 means 60%. Confidence is support(antecedent union consequent)/support(antecedent).

max_items.description: Supported maximum total items in a frequent set or rule: 2 (antecedent plus consequent). Native UI allows 1..1024, but other lengths are deferred. Lift filter is fixed at zero; singletons are retained. Native consequence-limit control remains at 1; port 2 is deferred.
